subject.title: Dashboard: export / import / share a workspace config

question: Should dashboard workspace import/export/share be sponsored as bundled dashboard plugin work after the Wave 1 stack lands, or should maintainers defer the distribution layer to external plugin/ClawHub work first?
rationale: The feature is aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it depends on unmerged bundled dashboard scope and crosses storage, approval, sandbox, and shareability boundaries that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
options.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution item and require storage, security, and API proof once the prerequisite dashboard stack is accepted.

options.title: Externalize Distribution First
options.body: Ask contributors to prove workspace-package import/export as an external plugin or ClawHub package until bundled dashboard scope is accepted.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Sharing
options.body: Leave the roadmap child open but do not queue implementation until the base dashboard and custom-widget approval flow are settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Wave 1
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the Tier 4 distribution item and require storage, security, and API proof once the prerequisite dashboard stack is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the plugin-tab Control UI seam and is the best available routing owner for bundled dashboard scope and security posture.
